p67_20260927T151347 (N, P W1K5, R1024 W1K5; one level c=8, 16 requests) after the calibration prompts were changed
summary: Two harness tests before this file was written, both through run_p67.sh with TEST=1. Before them, a probe outside the harness found that (1) on Windows several of uvicorn's worker processes calling listen() on the shared socket at the same moment fail with WinError 10022 and are restarted by uvicorn's supervisor, so for a few seconds after the first answer not every worker is serving; (2) a server left from an aborted probe still held the port and a new server bound it too (SO_REUSEADDR on Windows), so requests reached the old one. The harness therefore refuses to start a server while the port has a listener, waits until all W workers answer on fresh connections, and accepts only pids that descend from the server it started. Test 1: NIM health 0.826; four workers answered on P W4K75 and R1024 W4K75 (6 and 2 start-up restarts) and eight on R3 W8K75 (0); G2 passed on every worker (rails: adversarial blocked with 1 LLM call, clean passed with 3; P: 1 and 1), and in every probe round the NIM request delta equalled the LLM calls the responses reported; requests spread over all workers at c=8; the Part D rows carried verdicts and judge tokens; the port was free 4 s after each stop. It also showed that both calibration prompts began with the same word, which added a shared block to the measured template prefix on N (32 tokens instead of 16); the prompts were replaced by two with no common leading word. Test 2: NIM health 0.832; W1 servers (P W1K5, R1024 W1K5) answered with one worker, G2 passed; the calibration measured a fixed template prefix of 16 tokens on N and 80 on P (these are the values frozen in analysis_rules.prefix_thresholds); uvicorn's keep-alive closes were counted during R1024 W1K5's warm-up (3).
